== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix) (PC Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original and PC Errata only. Appendix A rewrites printed deploy +1 into an added deploy cost when deploying to the same location. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
